An unusual [[Alien/Legends|alien]] '''individual''' at one point possessed the mysterious teleportation device that later came to be known as [[Magwit's Mystifying Hoop]]. The would-be [[Magic/Legends|magician]] [[Wim Magwit]] eventually [[Thief/Legends|stole]] the device from the alien.<ref name="FF130">{{FactFile|130|MAG 1-2|Magwit's Mystifying Hoop}}</ref>
